messages:
maria: Hey — noticed during a quick usability session: when you collapse the left nav to get more canvas, the model catalog filters reset and the compare view clears selected rows. Repro: apply 3 filters -> open compare -> collapse nav -> expand nav -> filters gone, compare selection cleared.
ashley: ugh. did we unmount the whole filter panel on collapse? could be an optimization from last sprint.
sam: iirc we switch to a compact layout and rehydrate state from the URL, but we only persist search term, not filter selections. quick options: persist in URL or localStorage. URL is nicer for shareability.
maria: URL is fine but worry about super long query strings for complex filter sets. can we compress or shorthand?
leo: also another thing — compare table: pinning a row feels session-y now. users expect pin to be tied to the model/version, not the ephemeral compare session. decision needed.
ashley: noted. for the badges: a11y flagged contrast on the green performance badge — looks like it fails for small text. @kai can you confirm?
kai: confirmed — the green pill (current token green) fails AA at 12/14px. propose darker green (#116e34) or add 1px border and increase text weight. also add aria-labels like "Latency: 32 ms" so screen readers get context, not color.
sam: implementation-wise URL encoding is straightforward. we can use a compact mapping for keys to keep it short, or base64 the whole filter object. examples: /catalog?f=vt:r,ac:l,q:0.9 or /catalog?q=eyJ2IjpbInNv...==
maria: product call: default = persist filters in URL (human-readable shorthand where possible). add a user-level toggle (profile) "remember my filters" that uses localStorage for session-only memory. compare selection: persist in URL for shareable compares; keep quick-compare ephemeral.
ashley: microcopy suggestion: change "Pin version" to "Pin this version (keep in compare)" — more explicit. tooltip should show "Pinned by you" vs "Pinned globally".
leo: +1. also propose keyboard shortcut: when a row has keyboard focus press "P" to toggle pin. power users will love it.
sam: i'll draft an RFC/PR. plan: add URL encoder, fall back to storage if JS disabled, tests for encode/decode, aria label updates, and tweak badge color. pseudo: ```const encoded = encodeFilters(filters); history.replaceState(null, '', `/catalog?f=${encoded}`);```
ui-bot: deploy-preview created: PR #4321 — https://staging.redwood.ai/pr-4321 (staging link)
maria: awesome. @ashley can you QA the new copy and tooltip? @kai can you run an a11y checklist after the styling changes? @sam include unit + e2e for filter persistence and keyboard pin. :thumbsup:
kai: will run checklist and post results here after review.
ashley: i'll do copy pass today and check microcopy in context.
sam: starting work now, ETA for PR out by EOD tomorrow.
maria: thanks all — let's track in the catalog epic and add a small design spec for the shorthand URL mapping. :eyes:
